title: The normalized Roos comparison respects integer shifts
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site, $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ with exact countable products [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use the unbounded derived categories of $\mathcal A$ and of its strict positive-integer inverse towers [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian]. Let $\rho_X:\mathsf C(X)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\lim X$ be precisely the normalized Roos comparison of [lem-weil-strict-roos-comparison], where $\mathsf C(X)=\operatorname{Cone}(1-s:\prod X_n\to\prod X_n)[-1]$ and $R\lim$ is computed by K-injective tower resolutions and termwise inverse limit [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit, def-pur-kinjective-complex]. In coordinates $\mathsf C(X)^i=(\prod X_n)^{i-1}\oplus(\prod X_n)^i$ with differential $(y,x)\mapsto(-dy-(1-s)x,dx)$, for every $r\in\mathbf Z$ the map
$$\sigma^C_{X,r}:\mathsf C(X[r])\longrightarrow\mathsf C(X)[r],\qquad(y,x)\longmapsto((-1)^r y,x)$$
is a natural chain isomorphism. These maps give the coherent termwise Roos shift. Let $\sigma^{\lim}_{X,r}:R\lim(X[r])\to(R\lim X)[r]$ be the shift comparison represented by shifting a K-injective tower resolution $X\to I$ to $X[r]\to I[r]$ and identifying $\lim I[r]=(\lim I)[r]$. Then
$$\sigma^{\lim}_{X,r}\circ\rho_{X[r]}=\rho_X[r]\circ\sigma^C_{X,r}.$$
The normalization is retained: the inclusion $\lim I\to\mathsf C(I)$ with coordinates $(0,z)$ commutes with these shift maps. The equality is natural for all derived strict-tower morphisms, independent of the resolution and coherent for $r=0$ and addition of integers. In particular the equation applies after any natural strict-tower comparison commuting with the termwise shifts.
